data.name: Munaf
data.gender_notes: Munaf is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is patient and forbearing, especially when dealing with difficult situations or people. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'nuf', which means to be patient, forbearing, and forgiving. The name Munaf carries the meaning “Forbearing, Patient” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Munaf usually hope their child will grow to embody forbearing, patient and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encourages the bearer to be patient and forgiving in all aspects of life, especially during times of hardship and difficulty.
data.etymology: Munaf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Forbearing, Patient.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munaf total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مناف
in_arabic.meaning: المناف هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني المتنفس العالي
in_arabic.long_meaning: المناف هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، وهو من أسماء الله الحسنى التي تعبر عن علو الله تعالى وسموه، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفاتحة، وتعني المتنفس العالي الذي يتنفس منه الكائنات الحية

in_urdu.name: مناف

Patience and forbearance are virtues that are highly regarded in Islamic tradition. They are essential qualities that a believer must possess to navigate the challenges of life and ensure a peaceful and fulfilling existence. This name, therefore, serves as a constant reminder to the bearer to remain patient and forbearing in times of hardship, and inspire others to do the same.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Munaf holds great significance as a spiritual companion to the believer. It provides inspiration and guidance to remain steadfast in faith and uphold the moral values that are inherent to the Islamic way of life. By bearing the name of Munaf, one is constantly reminded to seek patience, forbearance, and forgiveness in their thoughts, words, and actions, in alignment with the teachings of the Quran and hadith. This, in turn, leads to a deeper and more meaningful connection with the divine, bringing spiritual growth and fulfillment to the individual.
